chunks: For we had led you astray; in fact we ourselves were astray.
ai.seo_question: What do the idols say about themselves on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the ultimate failure of idols to protect their devotees, emphasizing that divine deception (ghaww) is a consequence of human choice rather than arbitrary decree. It underscores the principle that false guides, whether idols or corrupt leaders, are themselves lost, serving as a warning against blind imitation (taqlid) of those lacking true spiritual insight.
